Header: Erosomyia mangiferae Tamil: Ma kalalai, Sinhala: Amba gadu messa

Prevention: Slash the weeds in and around the mango field
Maintain the field free of infested plant debris
Monitoring: Monitor the new shoot carefully after pruning
Observe for small reddish-brown spots on tender leaves and inflorescence.
Observe swollen and soft leaf tissue under the brown spot
Monitor black to brown colour midges using yellow sticky trap around the field
Direct Control: Plough the land to expose the pupa to sunlight
Cover the soil under the canopy of the tree with polythene sheet to destruct lifecycle of the pest.
Create smoke under the tree by using coconut husk or other materials to repel adult insects
